title: Designed with Confidence: Inside the Curated Collections at Ames and Easton
summary: Discover the four curated interior design collections at Ames and Easton by Tri Pointe Homes. Choose from Metro Modern, Farmhouse Fresh, Coffee House, or Coastal Vibes — professionally styled interiors offered in three thoughtfully designed tiers.
body_markdown:
When cabinetry, countertops, flooring, and hardware work together, the foundation of a home feels thoughtfully composed.


That harmony is at the heart of the design experience at Ames and Easton. Rather than starting from a blank slate, every home begins with one of four thoughtfully developed interior collections — Metro Modern, Farmhouse Fresh, Coffee House, or Coastal Vibes. Each collection was carefully crafted by our design team to create a unified look from the very beginning, ensuring every finish works beautifully together.


The result is a home that feels professionally styled — ready for you to layer in the pieces that make it uniquely yours.


## Four Distinct Expressions of Style


Each collection offers a unique point of view, allowing you to align your home with the aesthetic that speaks to you most.


**Metro Modern** pairs striking charcoal countertops with crisp flat white cabinetry and clean-lined finishes for a bold, high-contrast statement with urban-inspired appeal.


**Coffee House** layers rich cabinet tones and warm brass hardware. A classic subway tile kitchen backsplash delivers depth and personality to the space.


**Farmhouse Fresh** blends white cabinetry, soft gray neutrals, and traditional detailing to create warmth and balance with timeless character.


**Coastal Vibes** embraces soft, sun-washed finishes, such as lighter cabinetry tones, and bright, fresh materials that feel relaxed and naturally uplifting.


Because each collection is intentionally coordinated, countertops complement cabinetry, hardware enhances the palette, and flooring selections support the overall mood — creating a polished, unified backdrop throughout the home.


## Elevated in Three Thoughtful Tiers


Within each collection, you can select from three distinct tiers that build upon one another in both finish detail and flooring continuity.


Tier 2 introduces upgraded luxury vinyl plank flooring in select areas along with a distinctive backsplash that adds personality and visual interest.


Tier 3 expands luxury vinyl plank flooring throughout the main living areas and includes upgraded carpet, creating a seamless, room-to-room flow.


When you visit our model homes, you’re experiencing these collections with full design expression. Each model offers a firsthand look at how the materials interact, how tones balance, and how the design feels when fully realized.


## A Streamlined Path to Great Design


By beginning with a curated collection, the design process becomes focused and clear. Instead of navigating individual selections, you’re choosing from professionally composed combinations that already work beautifully together.


At the same time, you’re not limited to a single pre-selected look. With four distinct collections and three thoughtfully designed tiers, you have the ability to align your home with your personal style.


Because these collections were designed with intention from the start, we’re able to bring together beautiful finishes and thoughtful material selections in a way that maximizes both style and value. The result is a home that feels elevated and expertly designed — with meaningful choice built in.


It’s a confident approach to home design — streamlined, inspiring, and distinctly yours.
